SELECT l.* FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid AND l.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND l.business_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate} AND #{p.endDate} AND l.funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingChannelId}
AND concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.funding_channel_name_snapshot,l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot,l.note) ILIKE #{p.keyword} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select:
WITH expenses AS (), dimension_rows AS (
SELECT '二级分类''一级分类' AS group_name, COALESCE((array_agg(secondary_category_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1],'未选二级分类') (array_agg(primary_category_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label, COALESCE(secondary_category_id::text,'UNSPECIFIED') primary_category_id::text AS value, sum(paid_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name, NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,NULL::date AS latest_date, NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days,NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value, NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY secondary_category_idprimary_category_id
SELECT '商品价格''商品与单位' AS group_name, (array_agg(product_name_snapshot || ' · ' || unit_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label, product_id::text || '|' || unit_id::text AS value, avg(unit_price)sum(paid_amount) AS amount, count(*) AS item_count,sum(quantity) AS quantity,(array_agg(unit_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS unit_name,avg(unit_price) AS average_unit_price, min(unit_price) AS minimum_unit_price,max(unit_price) AS maximum_unit_price, (array_agg(unit_price ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS latest_unit_price, avg(paid_amount/quantity) AS average_actual_cost,max(business_date) AS latest_date, NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days,NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value, NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY product_id,unit_id
SELECT '支付方式' AS group_name,(array_agg(funding_channel_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label,funding_channel_id::text AS value, sum(paid_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name, NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,NULL::date AS latest_date, NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days,NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value, NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY funding_channel_id
SELECT '购买渠道' AS group_name,COALESCE((array_agg(purchase_channel_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1],'未指定') AS label, COALESCE(purchase_channel_id::text,'UNSPECIFIED') AS value,sum(paid_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count, NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name,NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,NULL::date AS latest_date,NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days, NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value,NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY purchase_channel_id
SELECT '常用地点' AS group_name,COALESCE((array_agg(location_label_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1],'未指定') AS label, COALESCE(location_label_id::text,'UNSPECIFIED') AS value,sum(paid_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count, NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name,NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,NULL::date AS latest_date,NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days, NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value,NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY location_label_id
SELECT '星期分布' AS group_name, CASE extract(isodow FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::int WHEN 1 THEN '周一' WHEN 2 THEN '周二' WHEN 3 THEN '周三' WHEN 4 THEN '周四' WHEN 5 THEN '周五' WHEN 6 THEN '周六' ELSE '周日' END AS label, 'WEEKDAY:' || extract(isodow FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::int AS value, sum(paid_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name, NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,NULL::date AS latest_date, NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days,NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value, NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM expenses GROUP BY extract(isodow FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::int UNION ALL SELECT '时段分布',CASE WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 6 THEN '凌晨' WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 12 THEN '上午' WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 18 THEN '下午' ELSE '晚上' END, 'TIME:' || CASE WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 6 THEN 'NIGHT' WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 12 THEN 'MORNING' WHEN extract(hour FROM business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 18 THEN 'AFTERNOON' ELSE 'EVENING' END, sum(paid_amount),count(*),NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::date,NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::uuid FROM expenses GROUP BY 2,3 UNION ALL SELECT '消费均值','日均','AVERAGE:DAY',COALESCE(sum(paid_amount),0)/GREATEST(#{p.endDate}-#{p.startDate}+1,1), count(*),NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric, NULL::date,NULL::numeric,'AVERAGE_DAILY',NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::uuid FROM expenses HAVING count(*)>0 UNION ALL SELECT '消费均值','月均','AVERAGE:MONTH',COALESCE(sum(paid_amount),0)/GREATEST((SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month',CAST(#{p.startDate} AS timestamp)), date_trunc('month',CAST(#{p.endDate} AS timestamp)),INTERVAL '1 month')),1), count(*),NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric, NULL::date,NULL::numeric,'AVERAGE_MONTHLY',NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::uuid FROM expenses HAVING count(*)>0 UNION ALL SELECT '消费均值','单条均值','AVERAGE:ENTRY',COALESCE(avg(paid_amount),0),count(*),NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar, NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::date,NULL::numeric, 'AVERAGE_ENTRY',NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::uuid FROM expenses HAVING count(*)>0
SELECT '高频商品' AS group_name,(array_agg(product_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label,product_id::text AS value,count(*)::numeric AS amount, count(*) AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS quantity,NULL::varchar AS unit_name,NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,max(business_date) AS latest_date, avg(business_date-previous_date) FILTER (WHERE previous_date IS NOT NULL) AS average_interval_days, NULL::varchar AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value,NULL::numeric AS actual_value,NULL::uuid AS entry_id FROM (SELECT expenses.*,lag(business_date) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY business_date,business_time,created_at,id) AS previous_date FROM expenses) sequenced GROUP BY product_id UNION ALL SELECT '长期未购买',product_name_snapshot,product_id::text,historical_count::numeric,historical_count, NULL::numeric,NULL::varchar,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric, business_date,NULL::numeric,'LONG_UNUSED',NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,id FROM ( SELECT l.*,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.product_id) AS historical_count, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.product_id ORDER BY l.business_time DESC,l.created_at DESC,l.id DESC) AS latest_rank FROM ledger_entry l JOIN product p ON p.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND p.id=l.product_id AND p.status='ACTIVE' WHERE l.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid AND l.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND l.business_date < #{p.startDate} AND l.funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingChannelId}
AND concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.funding_channel_name_snapshot,l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot,l.note) ILIKE #{p.keyword} ESCAPE '\'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expenses current_period WHERE current_period.product_id=l.product_id) ) historical WHERE latest_rank=1
) SELECT dimension_rows.*, CASE WHEN issue_type='LONG_UNUSED' THEN latest_date END AS drill_start_date, CASE WHEN issue_type='LONG_UNUSED' THEN latest_date END AS drill_end_date FROM dimension_rows ORDER BY CASE WHEN issue_type='LONG_UNUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, item_countamount DESC,label,value LIMIT #{p.limit}

WITH candidates AS (), evaluated AS ( SELECT c.*, history.sample_count,history.median_cost, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry duplicate WHERE duplicate.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND duplicate.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND duplicate.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND duplicate.product_id=c.product_id AND duplicate.paid_amount=c.paid_amount AND duplicate.funding_channel_id=c.funding_channel_id AND duplicate.business_time BETWEEN c.business_time-(#{p.duplicateWindowMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute') AND c.business_time AND (duplicate.business_time,duplicate.created_at,duplicate.id) < (c.business_time,c.created_at,c.id)) AS duplicate_match FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
SELECT COALESCE(max(sample_count),0) AS sample_count, avg(actual_cost) FILTER (WHERE position IN ((sample_count+1)/2,(sample_count+2)/2)) AS median_cost FROM ( SELECT history.paid_amount/history.quantity AS actual_cost, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY history.paid_amount/history.quantity) AS position, count(*) OVER () AS sample_count FROM ledger_entry history WHERE history.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND history.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND history.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND history.product_id=c.product_id AND history.unit_id=c.unit_id AND history.business_time >= c.business_time-(#{p.priceWindowDays} * INTERVAL '1 day') AND history.business_time < c.business_time ) ordered_history ) history ON true ), issues AS ( SELECT '数据质量' AS group_name,product_name_snapshot AS label,id::text AS value,paid_amount AS amount, 1::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS quantity,unit_name_snapshot AS unit_name,NULL::numeric AS average_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS minimum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS maximum_unit_price,NULL::numeric AS latest_unit_price, NULL::numeric AS average_actual_cost,business_date AS latest_date,NULL::numeric AS average_interval_days, 'UNCATEGORIZED' AS issue_type,NULL::numeric AS baseline_value,NULL::numeric AS actual_value,id AS entry_id, business_time,created_at FROM evaluated WHERE primary_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '数据质量',product_name_snapshot,id::text,paid_amount,1,NULL::numeric,unit_name_snapshot,NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,business_date,NULL::numeric,'HIGH_PRICE',median_cost, paid_amount/quantity,id,business_time,created_at FROM evaluated WHERE sample_count >= #{p.minimumPriceSamples} AND paid_amount/quantity > median_cost*#{p.highPriceMultiplier} UNION ALL SELECT '数据质量',product_name_snapshot,id::text,paid_amount,1,NULL::numeric,unit_name_snapshot,NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,business_date,NULL::numeric,'DUPLICATE',NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,id,business_time,created_at FROM evaluated WHERE duplicate_match ) SELECT group_name,label,value,amount,item_count,quantity,unit_name,average_unit_price,minimum_unit_price, maximum_unit_price,latest_unit_price,average_actual_cost,latest_date,average_interval_days,issue_type, baseline_value,actual_value,entry_id,NULL::date AS drill_start_date,NULL::date AS drill_end_date FROM issues ORDER BY business_time DESC,created_at DESC,entry_id,issue_type LIMIT #{p.limit}

SELECT l.* FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid AND l.entry_type='INCOME' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND l.business_date BETWEEN #{p.startDate} AND #{p.endDate} AND l.funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingChannelId}
AND concat_ws(' ',l.income_name,l.payer_name_snapshot,l.income_category_name_snapshot, l.funding_channel_name_snapshot,l.note) ILIKE #{p.keyword} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select:
WITH incomes AS (), dimension_rows AS (
SELECT '收入分类' AS group_name, (array_agg(income_category_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label, income_category_id::text AS value, sum(income_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,sum(income_amount) AS total_amount, max(business_date) AS latest_date FROM incomes GROUP BY income_category_id
SELECT '收款方式' AS group_name, (array_agg(funding_channel_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label, funding_channel_id::text AS value, sum(income_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,sum(income_amount) AS total_amount, max(business_date) AS latest_date FROM incomes GROUP BY funding_channel_id
SELECT '付款方' AS group_name, (array_agg(payer_name_snapshot ORDER BY business_time DESC,id DESC))[1] AS label, payer_id::text AS value, sum(income_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,sum(income_amount) AS total_amount, max(business_date) AS latest_date FROM incomes GROUP BY payer_id
SELECT '收入名称' AS group_name,income_name AS label,income_name AS value, sum(income_amount) AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,sum(income_amount) AS total_amount, max(business_date) AS latest_date FROM incomes GROUP BY income_name
SELECT '收入频次' AS group_name,income_name AS label,income_name AS value, count(*)::numeric AS amount,count(*) AS item_count,sum(income_amount) AS total_amount, max(business_date) AS latest_date FROM incomes GROUP BY income_name
) SELECT * FROM dimension_rows ORDER BY amount DESC,label,value LIMIT #{p.limit}
